corpus.note: Line numbers are valid only for the commit named here. The source is NOT committed: it is third-party or personal material, and the provenance rule keeps it out of the repository. Fetch it and point the env var at the checkout before scoring.

fields.file: the file holding the answer, spelled the way `source` says
fields.expects: the lines in that file that really answer the question
fields.asks: what kind of thing the question wants: constant, behaviour, error, api, structure
fields.wording: named = the question uses a word that also appears in the text. paraphrase = it deliberately avoids them. NEITHER may contain the identifier it is looking for - that would measure string matching, not retrieval
fields.anchor: the exact line the question was written from, used only to resolve `expects`
